items.definition:
miracle
It was a miracle that no one was seriously hurt.

observation
Scientific observation is crucial for research.

provider
Our internet provider offers fast speeds.

publisher
She sent her manuscript to a book publisher.

retreat (withdrawal, quiet place)
The army ordered a strategic retreat.

rookie
The new police officer is still a rookie.

separation
The separation of powers is a key principle of democracy.

the act of stealing
The police are investigating the theft of the car.

a device that controls the flow of liquid or gas
The plumber replaced the faulty valve.

a country or area under the full or partial political control of another country
India was once a British colony.

the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college
The school is reviewing its new curriculum.

a triangular tract of sediment at the mouth of a river
The Nile Delta is very fertile.

a thing with distinct and independent existence
The company is a separate legal entity.

a person who supports feminism
She is a strong feminist and advocates for equal rights.

a point where two subjects, systems, etc., meet and interact
The user interface of the software is very intuitive.

the activity or profession of writing for newspapers, magazines, or news websites or preparing news to be broadcast
She studied journalism at university.

milligram (a unit of mass)
Take 500 mg of this medicine twice a day.

the action of following or pursuing someone or something; an activity that one engages in as a hobby or interest
She is dedicated to the pursuit of knowledge.

a long, narrow hilltop, mountain range, or watershed
We hiked along the mountain ridge, enjoying the views.

a person who studies a great deal and has a lot of knowledge about a particular subject
She is a respected scholar in the field of ancient history.

a person who excels at a particular activity
She's an ace at tennis, winning every match.

a baby or young child; an attractive young woman (informal)
The little babe slept peacefully in her crib.

the ability or power to do something
The new software has enhanced capabilities.

the act or process of closing something; a sense of resolution or conclusion
The family sought closure after the long legal battle.

a person who defends someone or something
The team's best defender blocked the shot.

an article in a newspaper or magazine expressing the opinion of the editor or publisher
The newspaper's editorial criticized the new policy.

agreement or concord; pleasing arrangement of parts
The different cultures lived together in harmony.

a thing made by combining two different elements
The new car is a hybrid, running on both gasoline and electricity.

a general review or summary of a subject
The presentation provided a brief overview of the project.

a small administrative district typically having its own church and a priest or pastor
The local church serves the entire parish.

a part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole
The proportion of women in the workforce has increased.

violent uncontrollable anger
He was filled with rage after hearing the news.

a non-commissioned officer in the army or police force
The sergeant gave orders to the new recruits.

a collection of historical documents or records
We keep old records in the company archive.

an impressive display or range of a particular type of thing
There was an impressive array of food at the buffet.

the status of being a citizen of a particular country
He applied for dual citizenship.

general agreement
After a long discussion, they reached a consensus.

a formal or explicit statement or announcement
The declaration of independence was signed in 1776.

a difference or contrast between similar things or people
There is a clear distinction between the two theories.

the conclusion that can be drawn from something although it is not explicitly stated
The implication of his words was clear.

a naturally occurring solid material from which a metal or valuable mineral can be extracted
Iron ore is a key component in steel production.

an act of attacking a place with bombs
The city suffered heavy bombing during the war.

a system of religious veneration and devotion directed toward a particular figure or object
The documentary explored the history of the cult.

a claim or dispute brought to a court of law
The company faced a major lawsuit.

a violent disturbance of the peace
The police were called to control the riot.

a list of people or things
Check the team roster for tomorrow's game.

A claim or assertion that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically made without proof.
The police are investigating an allegation of fraud.

The producing of offspring.
The breeding season for birds is usually in spring.

The action of confirming something.
We are waiting for confirmation of our flight details.

A person, animal, or plant with an unusual physical abnormality.
He's a real fitness freak.

The activity of playing games of chance for money.
He lost a lot of money due to his gambling habit.

intense sorrow
He felt deep grief after the loss.

a central point of activity
The city is a major transport hub.

a small house, especially in the countryside
We stayed in a hunting lodge.

a person involved in wholesale trade
The merchant sold spices and textiles.

a traditional story; a widely held but false belief
The story of Atlantis is a famous myth.

a tiny portion of matter; a minor part of speech
Dust particles were floating in the air.

a minister in charge of a Christian church or congregation
The pastor delivered a sermon.

a person who rises in opposition or armed resistance against an established government or ruler
The rebels fought for their freedom.

the action of rotating around an axis or center
The Earth's rotation causes day and night.

a charge payable for permission to use a bridge or road; the number of deaths or casualties
The accident took a heavy toll.

a woman who has lost her husband by death and has not remarried
The old widow lived alone.

a person responsible for running a business, organization, etc.
The system administrator fixed the network issue quickly.

a thing that is accepted as true or as certain to happen, without proof
Your assumption about the project's timeline was incorrect.
